description: React-like component code for managing product categories in the frontend of an inventory management system, using Qwik framework. Implements UI for listing, creating, editing, and deleting categories, with modal dialogs and actions conditioned on user roles.

methods.name: startCreate
methods.description: Initializes the form state for creating a new category.

methods.name: startEdit
methods.description: Loads existing category data into form state for editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the new or edited category to the data store.

methods.name: del
methods.description: Deletes a category by filtering it out from the data store.

methods.name: closeModal
methods.description: Closes the modal dialog by unchecking the checkbox input.
